import java.util.*;

public class RainboyVariant1 extends PrintWriter {
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        RainboyVariant1 instance = new RainboyVariant1();
        instance.execute();
        instance.flush();
    }

    int encode(int[] array, int length) {
        int result = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < length; j++) {
            result = result * 3 + array[j];
        }
        return result;
    }

    void decode(int[] array, int length, int code, int base) {
        for (int j = length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            array[j] = code % base;
            code /= base;
        }
    }

    void execute() {
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        if (n < m) {
            int temp = n; n = m; m = temp;
        }
        int p = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) p *= 3;
        int[] dp = new int[p];
        int[] dq = new int[p];
        int[] aa = new int[m];
        int[] bb = new int[m];
        Arrays.fill(aa, 1);
        Arrays.fill(dp, -1);
        dp[encode(aa, m)] = 0;
        while (n-- > 0) {
            Arrays.fill(dq, -1);
            for (int a = 0; a < p; a++) {
                if (dp[a] < 0) continue;
                decode(aa, m, a, 3);
                for (int b = 0; b < (1 << m); b++) {
                    decode(bb, m, b, 2);
                    boolean invalid = false;
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        if (aa[j] == 0 && bb[j] == 0) {
                            invalid = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (invalid) continue;
                    int count = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        if (bb[j] == 1) {
                            bb[j] = 2;
                            count++;
                        }
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        if (bb[j] == 0 && (aa[j] == 2 || (j > 0 && bb[j - 1] == 2) || (j + 1 < m && bb[j + 1] == 2))) {
                            bb[j] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                    int newA = encode(bb, m);
                    dq[newA] = Math.max(dq[newA], dp[a] + m - count);
                }
            }
            int[] temp = dp; dp = dq; dq = temp;
        }
        int answer = 0;
        for (int a = 0; a < p; a++) {
            if (dp[a] <= answer) continue;
            decode(aa, m, a, 3);
            boolean bad = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                if (aa[j] == 0) {
                    bad = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!bad) answer = dp[a];
        }
        println(answer);
    }
}
